authorization: Direct investigator authorization and explicit Milestone8 instruction permit real internal representation fitting/evaluation; no external publication or agent inference
primary_population: all278865 native fire IDs;1/2/3+ strata; task-specific undefined masks
representation_input: Validated observed-property state from native increments and exact calendar support, including explicit undefined-feature masks; this is feature-state encoding, not a raw polygon or full-sequence neural experiment
primary_comparisons: frozen downstream transfer versus same-label raw-state heads

self_supervised: reconstruct input state without future labels

splits: Reuse preserved proposed whole-fire70/15/15 hash split; report temporal/geographic strata separately; these are public development cases, not pristine unseen data
preprocessing: Training-fire-only means/scales and median imputation of undefined MODEL INPUT features with explicit real support-mask channels. Labels retain undefined masks. No missing dates or source values imputed; no raw sequence padding.
pca: Training-only observed-state PCA. Requested dimensions capped to actual numerical covariance rank. Report source degrees of freedom separately from nonlinear-feature covariance rank; no invented padded axes.
probes: fixed-seed tanh feature-map ridge,32 nonlinear features
primary_metric: Equal-fire standardized property MSE and per-stratum results; exact native operations independently evaluated; approximate recovery is not exact preservation
retrieval: Independent property-ranked relevance, full training gallery,4096 deterministic stratified test queries, same-fire exclusion; per-stratum results and paired fire uncertainty. Full-ranking diagnostics may use a declared fixed smaller gallery, explicitly separate from full-gallery top10.
uncertainty: Conditional whole-fire paired bootstrap,256 replicates; report clusters and no training-refit/population inference. No confirmatory significance without scientist-reviewed meaningful-effect thresholds; Holm only on a valid declared comparison family.
conditions: A coordinates only, no source metadata
B same dates/source/support sidecar, no native scientific values
C explicit charged native fallback, not counted as embedding preservation
cost: Record fitting/materialization/index/query/fallback/cache/refresh costs and unknown physical I/O; comparable measured-workload Pareto frontiers only
scientific_limits: Cumulative observed area means sum of retained increments, not complete physical lifetime
No ecological analog, causality, operational forecast or universal latent-space claims
Model-family capacity and supervision differ and will be reported
Single seed is not model-training uncertainty
